unknown_field_policy: invalid unless the selected TYPE schema explicitly permits an extension namespace

common_value_types.string: single physical line UTF-8 text after ': '
common_value_types.path: repository-relative or explicitly qualified artifact path

duplicate_behavior.scalar: invalid if the same scalar field appears more than once

semantic_constraints: All load-bearing TASK content must be recoverable from the envelope without requiring the optional Markdown body.
ALLOWED, TEST, and HANDBACK must each appear at least once; use an explicit value such as 'none' or 'not applicable' only when that is truthfully the contract.

duplicate_behavior.scalar: invalid if the same scalar field appears more than once

semantic_constraints: CANDIDATE_REVISION must identify the exact reviewed revision; structural validity does not waive exact-identity or authorized-reading-set obligations.

duplicate_behavior.scalar: invalid if the same scalar field appears more than once

semantic_constraints: If relevant repository/file artifacts exist, each relevant artifact must be represented by ARTIFACT using '<path> | <purpose>'; READ or ATTACHMENT alone do not satisfy the artifact-map obligation.
Structural validity does not make the memo authoritative; Service Memo remains transport/handoff only.

blank_line_before_delimiter_policy: at most one empty physical line is allowed between the last FIELD line and the delimiter; it is ignored
empty_value_policy: invalid unless the selected TYPE schema explicitly permits an empty value; no v1.1.0 TYPE permits empty load-bearing values
delimiter_policy: when a Markdown body is present, the first physical line exactly equal to '---' after the envelope fields (optionally preceded by one allowed empty line) terminates the envelope; without a body, the delimiter may be omitted and EOF terminates the envelope
field_order_policy: scalar field order is not significant; repeatable values preserve encounter order

duplicate_policy_default.scalar: invalid if the same scalar field appears more than once
duplicate_policy_default.repeatable: valid; append each value in encounter order

structural_validation_note: Registry/schema validity is necessary but not sufficient for semantic contract validity; normative artifact-content obligations still apply.
